input.contract_yaml:
# Pharmacy claim lines from a (synthetic) pharmacy-benefit vendor: one row per dispensed
# prescription, one Excel workbook per day.
feed: healthcare.pharmacy_claims
version: 1
owner: vendor-ops@example.com
description: >
  Daily workbook of pharmacy claims: the prescription claim, the member, the fill date, the
  drug (NDC), days' supply, quantity, the amount paid and the dispensing pharmacy (NPI). All
  data is synthetic.
classification: restricted
source:
  channels: [minio, sftp, api]
  filename_pattern: "pharmacy_claims_*.xlsx"
  # The business date in the name (pharmacy_claims_YYYYMMDD.xlsx): a real date, not after the
  # day it was received and at most 7 days before; otherwise FILE.NAME_DATE.
  filename_date:
    regex: "^pharmacy_claims_([0-9]+)"
    format: "%Y%m%d"
    max_days_before_received: 7
    max_days_after_received: 0
format: { type: excel, sheet: Claims, header_row: 1 }
expected_arrival: { cron: "0 7 * * *", grace: 2h }
on_row_violation: quarantine_row
max_bad_row_ratio: 0.05
min_rows: 1
columns:
  - { name: rx_claim_id, type: string, required: true, unique: true, pattern: "^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{6}$" }
  - { name: member_id, type: string, required: true, pattern: "^[A-Z][0-9]{9}$" }
  - { name: fill_date, type: date, required: true, min: "2020-01-01", max: today }
  - { name: ndc, type: string, required: true, pattern: "^[0-9]{11}$" }
  - { name: days_supply, type: integer, required: true, allowed: [30, 60, 90] }
  - { name: quantity, type: integer, required: true, allowed: [30, 60, 90, 120] }
  - { name: paid_amount, type: decimal, required: true, min: 0, max: 10000000, pattern: "^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]{1,2})?$" }
  - { name: pharmacy_npi, type: string, required: true, pattern: "^[0-9]{10}$" }
